messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: service=api gateway tag=v2.0.0 window=2026-03-20T02:00Z->02:30Z. Rollout stages: 10%/30%/60%. Operators: @prashant @sasha. Runbook RB-1229.
prashant: Looks good. Notes: we've pinned critical mobile clients until +24h. Need a quick checklist for support.
sasha: Checklist: monitor error-rate >0.5% for 5m -> rollback; latency p50 >150ms or p95 >600ms for 10m -> rollback. Telemetry tag: release_tag=v2-canary. Alert on generation_coherence_regression.
prashant: How do we pin clients? Support needs command. Also where are the release notes?
sasha: Pinning is header-based. Example:
```curl -H 'X-Redwood-API-Version: v1' https://api.redwood.ai/generate```
To pin to v2 use v2. Support can also use gateway flag 'client_pin'. Deploy pin command (ops):
`deployctl pins set client=mobile-android version=v1 until=2026-03-21T02:00Z`
lin: Mobile eng says SDK 1.4.2 still defaults to v1 header. Are we okay keeping them pinned?
maya: I'll add release notes callout for embeddings output shape change. Migration snippet will be included.
ops: Ops checklist: preflight smoke on canary (10 req/s) for 15m; validate auth, streaming, and large-payload routes. If canary error spike -> immediate traffic shift to v1: `deployctl rollback --auto`.
prashant: @deploy-bot can we set auto fallback policy to 'route-to-v1' on threshold? Also enable verbose gateway logs for first 30m.
deploy-bot: auto-fallback enabled (route_to=v1). Thresholds set per SLO. Verbose gateway logs: true for 30m. Notifying #support and #customers via release-notes webhook.
sasha: Add A/B metric: keep 20% shadow to experimental model. Watch generation_coherence_regression; if delta >2% stop rollout.
prashant: I'll be oncall 02:00-03:30. Sasha takes 03:30-05:00. Confirmed. :thumbsup:
maya: Posting release notes now: https://docs.internal.redwood/release/1229 (draft). Ping me for edits.
